name: Yunagi Chailley
source:
An easy-going Demon fox (鬼狐族) who comes to Grasesta looking for an opportunity to strike it rich. Her tribe is renowned for its unnatural strength, which Yunagi exploits by wielding an umbrella equipped with a katana as the handle. Her strength and skills quickly earn her the status of free citizen and she is a regular participant when the "Disaster" attacks Grasesta. Although she earns much from dangerous expeditions, she blows all of her money on gambling leaving her perennially poor.

[Spoiler] Females from the Demon Fox tribe are trained to use umbrellas both as weapons and as a tool to ride air currents to move easily from one elevation to another. The clan does not have a custom of wearing underwear either.

Yunagi was brought up in the arts of self defence but also the expectation that she marry and have lots of babies. As she was bored with stereotypical constraints, she left her village and came to Grasesta. She loves money and having fun at the same time. 

Because Demon foxes are extremely fecund and have a 100% chance of impregnation during unprotected sex, Yunagi insists Judar use a condom made of strengthened fish skin when she propositions him for sex in return for living expenses. 

Yunagi's penchant for gambling and losing her living expenses eventually lead her to participate in an illegal underground arena run by the corrupt priest of Ylliun Johannes. Judar learns of this from Eutre (who has ratted on Yunagi and hopes to cash in when the arena is raided) and goes to save her. If they win the battle against the arena beast, Yunagi has unprotected sex with Judar and pledges to repay him for the debt she owes him by living in his house and cooking his meals as a permanent party member. [/Spoiler]
